brief:
Three years of Israel's military campaign in Gaza has forced families to live in severely damaged buildings with few safe alternatives, according to Al Jazeera English. Residents lack adequate shelter options as the destruction of residential infrastructure continues to limit where displaced Palestinians can take refuge.

The precarious housing situation reflects the scale of destruction across Gaza, with families choosing to remain in structurally unsafe buildings rather than face homelessness or overcrowded displacement camps.
dek: Three years of Israel's war has left families in Gaza living in damaged buildings, with few safe alternatives available.
title: Gaza families shelter in collapsing buildings as war destroys housing stock
